description: Detect edges in any photo with a real Sobel operator, rendered as glowing outlines.

faqs.a: Horizontal and vertical Sobel kernels measure brightness change per pixel; the combined magnitude becomes the edge brightness.
Black background with white edge lines, like a technical sketch.
faqs.q: What does the result look like?

faqs.a: A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Edge Detect
